correctness.rationale: For n>=4, every length-n factor has a 1, and opposite starting parities have ones in opposite local parity classes. Fixed-parity factor equalities decimate to length floor(n/2) or ceil(n/2) factors. Monotonicity R(m+1)>=R(m) gives R(n)=2R(floor(n/2)), and the earlier repeat position scales identically. Direct bases R(1)=2,Q(1)=0; R(2)=3,Q(2)=2; R(3)=4,Q(3)=0 complete the proof for every n. The executed independent byte-exact checker covered all n<=256 and eighteen large lengths through 8192.
